inspection: Native generation displayed the full PNG; its unchanged saved copy was inspected with view_image. A same-dimension JPEG inspection derivative was used after the PNG viewer displayed only a tiny patch. The delivered PNG stayed byte-identical.
impression_before_control_comparison: A quiet industrial observatory portrait: concentrated face and pointing fingertip beside an analog recorder, warm copper and lamp light in the foreground, cold snow peaks and a small moon beyond the doorway. The bob and net sleeves carry the costume design while the raised crown strand provides a playful small silhouette cue. The subject reads as absorbed in equipment work; the instrument, guards, paper and garment coexist convincingly in one photographic space.
strengths: The warm skin/copper against blue snow hierarchy binds portrait and facility.
The recorder gaze and reachable fingertip give the outfit a present-tense action.
Sleeve holes and both dorsal guards are large enough to inspect.
limitations: The one-eye fringe appears on the actor-right side; the baseline incidentally assigned actor-left. This does not change the frozen side-neutral one-eye feature test, but is a staging mismatch.
The raised crown tuft is more curved and loose than a neat isolated spike.
The intentionally covered eye cannot be compared with the source eye.
user_acceptance: pending; no direct requester judgment received
